meta.title: VERIFY: after the access token expired the app refreshes silently and stays signed in
meta.requirement: AC9 — refresh once on 401 and retry
precondition: ARM case done ≥ 15.5 min ago; the device was not used for other sign-ins
steps: Wait until 15.5 min after the arm (script waits ≤ 8 min, else Blocked)
Cold start the app → open Profile
expected: Still signed in as the armed user, no 'session has ended' toast — UI tree + screenshot
DB: the user's refresh tokens grew past the arm count and one is marked replaced (rotated by the refresh) — DB

checkpoints.name: ≥ 15.5 min since the arm (else run again later)
